title: linux-omarchy: carry Apple SMC charge-threshold patches
author: rand0mdud3
body:
Carries Jordan Brough's LKML series ([PATCH 0/2] hwmon: (applesmc) add native charge_control_end_threshold support) as 0752 (ACPI sbs hook mechanism) + 0753 (applesmc charge threshold), for pre-T2 Intel Macs whose batteries register via SBS. Related: omacom/omarchy#11593.

Verification, all on MacBookPro11,5 (BCM43602-era board, kernel 7.2.5):
- Full stack (0750 + 0751 + these two) applies cleanly with patch --fuzz=0, the exact setting this PKGBUILD uses. No conflicts with the existing applesmc patches.
- Both modules build warning-free against 7.2.5 headers and load clean: sysfs node appears, reads match SMC truth, 85/80 write round trip verified both directions against an independent SMC reader, fans/temps nominal throughout, zero Oops.

Notes for maintainers: no .sig files attached -- signatures are yours to add (same situation as #494/#499); the two b2sums entries are SKIP mirroring the local-file convention. Happy to rework numbering/naming to house style.
